info.title: Transnet HTTP API
info.description: Complete no-authentication contract between trusted Island-port and Transnet. Stateful operations use X-Learner-Id; no cookies, sessions, OIDC, or bearer authentication are accepted.

tags.name: translation
tags.description: Loopback direct translation that preserves the legacy contract.

x-transnet-request-correlation.description: Every response, including route misses, payload-limit failures, and configured CORS preflights, contains X-Request-Id. A single safe supplied value is preserved; missing, duplicate, or unsafe values are replaced with a generated ULID.
x-transnet-request-correlation.safeInboundValue: 1 through 128 ASCII letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, or periods

x-transnet-cors.credentials: Returned only when http.allow_credentials is enabled and the origin is exactly configured; wildcard origins are rejected.

x-transnet-request-body-limit.description: Oversized /translate requests return the legacy direct error envelope. Oversized /v1 requests return an RFC 9457-style problem with code payload_too_large.

x-transnet-cache-policy.description: Successful /v1/lookups responses and all versioned problem responses use Cache-Control: no-store. The health and legacy translation routes do not set this directive.

get.summary: Report whether the HTTP process can serve requests.
get.description: This process-health check does not probe model providers.

200.description: The HTTP process is serving requests.

get.description: Suitable for a supervisor that only needs to know whether the HTTP process is alive.

get.summary: Report whether the process may accept traffic.
get.description: The default process uses an always-ready probe. The implemented route can return 503 when its injected readiness probe reports an unavailable required dependency.

503.description: The injected readiness probe does not permit traffic.

post.description: Legacy direct-translation contract. The process selects its configured short- or long-text provider internally; provider choice is not part of this API. This route uses the direct error envelope, not the versioned problem envelope.

400.description: The request body is not valid JSON.

422.description: Text is blank after trimming or either language code is malformed.

503.description: The selected translation provider could not produce a response after its bounded policy.

post.summary: Return a synchronous model-generated English-learning card.
post.description: The default process wires a model-backed learning lookup. It does not expose canonical lexical content, retrieval, persistence, caller identity, or a Web UI through this operation. Every returned assertion is generated, canonical identifiers are null, evidence lists are empty, and the response is never shared from an HTTP cache.

200.description: A synchronous model-generated learning card. Cache-Control is always no-store.

400.description: The request is not valid JSON or includes unknown fields. The stable code is invalid_json. Cache-Control is always no-store.

413.description: The request body exceeds http.max_request_body_bytes. The stable code is payload_too_large. Cache-Control is always no-store.

422.description: A well-formed lookup fails validation. The stable code is validation_error. Cache-Control is always no-store.

502.description: The learning model returned output that does not satisfy the structured contract. The stable code is invalid_model_output. Cache-Control is always no-store.

503.description: The model is not configured or cannot return a result. The stable code is learning_model_unavailable. Cache-Control is always no-store.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: An optional correlation value. A single safe value is echoed; an unsafe, duplicate, or absent value is replaced with a generated ULID.
Correlation identifier selected for this response.

NoStore.description: Versioned lookup responses and versioned problem responses are not storable by HTTP caches.

RequestId.description: Header-safe correlation identifier. Generated values are ULIDs.

text.description: Source text. It must contain at least one non-whitespace character after trimming.

translation.description: The text returned by the selected translation model.

Bcp47LanguageTag.description: The conservative BCP-47-shaped language-tag form accepted by the service.

query.description: A nonblank word or short expression after Unicode NFC normalization.

source_language.description: Input language, or auto for model language detection.

target_language.description: The current basic core supports English output only; comparison is ASCII case-insensitive.

context.description: Optional disambiguating context. Blank context is treated as absent after Unicode NFC normalization.

explanation_language.description: Language for supporting explanations and localized glosses.

learner_level.description: Optional CEFR level for explanation adaptation.

detail.description: Brief limits entries and selected nested lists; full keeps model-provided detail.

include.description: Omit to include relations and word history. practice_preview is accepted but currently produces a warning instead of preview data.

warnings.description: Includes a model-generated, non-canonical warning; may include provider or request-mode limitations.

normalized.description: Unicode NFC-normalized query used for the model request.

language.description: Source language returned by the structured learning model.

source_sense_id.description: Always null in the default model-only runtime; no canonical source sense is exposed.

context_relevance.description: Always null in the default model-only runtime; no canonical context reranking score is exposed.

sense_id.description: Always null in the default model-only runtime; no canonical English sense is exposed.

evidence_ids.description: Always empty in the default model-only runtime.
Always empty in the default model-only runtime.
Always empty in the default model-only runtime.

relation_id.description: Always null in the default model-only runtime.

detail.description: Safe, human-readable detail that never echoes request content or provider output.
